Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 15002 of 2023
Applicant :- Vineet Saini
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, Lko.

And Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Vimal Kishor Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shiv Shankar Singh
Hon'ble Karunesh Singh Pawar,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
In the statement under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., the prosecutrix has stated that she of her own accord and free will went away with the applicant to Punjab and there she married to him in temple.
No allegation at all has been levelled against the present applicant by the victim.
No ossification test of the victim has been conducted by the investigating officer.

Attention of the Court has been invited towards report card of the victim issued by the Basic Siksha Parishad, Barabanki wherein her date birth is mentioned as 12.05.2007 and in another date of birth certificate issued by the Baba Narayan Das Smarak Higher Secondary School which is on record as Annexure No. 7 to the petition, her date of birth is mentioned as 01.01.2007.

entities.text: Baba Narayan Das Smarak Higher Secondary School
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In the family register, her date of birth is recorded as 01.04.2002 and in Aadhar Card also her date of birth is recorded as 01.04.2002.

It is contended that Vineet Saini vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161231438/

It is further submitted that the applicant is languishing in jail since 10.01.2023 without having any criminal antecedent.

entities.text: Vineet Saini vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There is no possibility of the applicant of fleeing away after being released from jail or tampering with the witnesses.
In case the applicant is enlarged on bail, he shall not misuse the liberty of bail.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts as argued by the learned counsel for the applicant.

On due consideration to the statements of the victim recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.;
different date of births available on record as well as considering the fact that the ossification test of the victim has not been conducted; applicant is languishing in jail since 10.01.2023 without having any criminal antecedent and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I find it to be a fit case for enlarging the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Vineet Saini, involved in Case Crime/FIR No. 563/2022, under Sections 363/366/376 IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, Police Station - Masauli, District - Barabanki, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.

(iii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iv) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(v) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(vi) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the Vineet Saini vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home, ... on 17 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/161231438/

under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.
